thread:
maria: Quick alert 3 we saw a surge in a dedicated customer's invoice preview after yesterday's sampling shim rollout. Tracing shows dynamic sampling executing before route enrichment.

raj: Yikes. Can you paste where the sampling hook runs?

maria: Canary flow runs the sampler in the edge proxy right after auth but before enrichment.

leo: That means the downstream tallyer uses the sample header as the eventual routing signal. If enrichment later rewrites route/plan, charges get misattributed.

sophie: This matches tickets from CS 3 some tenants reported >100% token charges on preview. Saw pages to SRE. @oncall?

oncall: Confirmed. Alerts for invoice-preview mismatches and some silent-kv retries. billing-bot shows duplicate ingest for certain request ids.

maria: Repro steps: tenant X -> proxy samples (sample=true, sid=xyz) -> enrichment replaces route_id/plan -> tallyer consumes sample and increments tenant X's provisional ledger.

raj: So early sampling bakes in whatever header is present. Our dedupe key is currently (sample_id, ts). We need to include canonical attributes or wait for enrichment.

leo: Options: 1) shift sampling to post-enrichment so samples get canonical attrs; 2) keep early sampling but emit a reconciled_sample after enrichment with enriched fields and prefer reconciled events in tallying.

sophie: Moving sampling later simplifies accounting but could increase p95 latency on the proxy and raise upstream bandwidth. Some large customers depend on early drop to reduce load.

maria: Early sampling has been saving us ingest costs. Moving it could materially raise cost for high-traffic tenants.

raj: Could we do a cheap enrichment lookup in the proxy just for sampling (materialize route_id/plan only)? That would keep latency low but supply canonical keys.

leo: Last time we trialed a light join it added ~3ms p95. Might be OK for canary but could violate p99 SLAs on dedicated instances.

sophie: Middle ground: keep early drop, but emit a reconciled_sample event when enrichment completes. Aggregators prefer reconciled_sample if present. Keeps early savings and corrects attribution.

maria: I like the reconciled_sample approach. Implementation: reconciled event contains original sample_id + enriched route_id/plan. Tallyer logic updated to prefer reconciled over provisional; fallback to provisional if reconciled doesn't arrive within TTL.

raj: Schema updates: new topic reconciled-samples, new header reconciled=true, and TTL (recommend 2m). Need to ensure tallyer can swap counts atomically without double-charges.

leo: Tallyer changes: store provisional_count keyed by sample_id. On reconciled, apply compensating adjust: decrement provisional route's counters and increment canonical route. Requires idempotent replace semantics and ordering or compensator transactions.

sophie: We should surface provisional vs reconciled in the invoice preview UI so ops/CS can see adjustments. Transparency will reduce confusion.

billing-bot: Note: if reconciled events cross billing windows (>24h delay) we risk invoice-level adjustments. Recommend TTL <= 2h; prefer <= 2m for preview stability.

maria: Action list: (1) Raj + Leo spike reconciled_sample shim and perf (EOD tomorrow). (2) Maria drafts tallyer dedupe/idempotency PR. (3) Sophie specs console card showing provisional vs reconciled counts with a tooltip.

raj: Spiking shim today. If extra latency >5ms p95 we will revert the canary.

leo: I'll design the idempotent replace and a test harness for races and out-of-order reconciles.

sophie: I'll add a "provisional adjustments" card to invoice preview and a rollback playbook for the canary. Also plan a short CS FAQ.

maria: Agreed 3 data accuracy beats tiny cost wins for dedicated billing. We'll implement reconciled_sample with strict TTL and console visibility.

raj: Will notify #customer-success once we have a timeline so they can proactively message impacted tenants.

oncall: Rollout suggestion: enable debug tracing for sample reconciliation for 1 hour during canary (flag sampling.reconcile.debug=true) so we can validate reconciliations.

maria: I'll open a rollout ticket with debug flag and link PRs. :thumbsup:

sophie: Thanks team. Good trade-off work. :sparkles:
